microsoft-decision-1-a2-20261012.note: Preliminary A2 re-run of Microsoft-Decision-1 (300 sealed A2 items + 300 public items). Language cells come from the scorer's A2 breakdowns; subject-topic and use-case cells cover its labelled public items only, because the A2 sealed items are a separate subset that was not part of this draw's labelling run.

v1.6-regular-20261012.labelling: Subject topics and use cases: each of this draw's 1,500 items was labelled after its release with one subject topic (v1.2 list) and one TypeSafe use case by Winnow-12B Q8 on our own GPU pod, with the same model, questions, taxonomy and T1-T3/U1/U2 item-group rules as the v1.6.4 and v1.6.9 draws; where a uc1 item was written for a use case, that authoring use case is used. Sealed items stayed on our own infrastructure. On 75 public items checked by hand afterwards, topic agreement is 71/75 = 94.7 % (68/75 = 90.7 % counting three borderline items as misses); policy-style routing items are filed under the subject of the request, as in the earlier draws, and no rule was added.
